title: Propensity Straight-Through Gradients for Discrete Stochastic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.25631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous-time Markov chains (CTMCs) provide the backbone for modeling discrete stochastic dynamics across applied, physical, and biological sciences. Their integration with modern gradient-based machine learning, however, is limited by the hard categorical event selection intrinsic to Gillespie-type simulation algorithms. We exploit the affine state update to obtain the exact one-step conditional-mean sensitivity by differentiating normalized reaction propensities. We pair this backward rule with exact forward trajectories to define the propensity straight-through (PST) estimator. At the trajectory level, we show that one-step sensitivities composed across events can depart from the exact multistep sensitivity. We derive the resulting per-step discrepancy in closed form and prove that it vanishes identically for affine downstream dependence. PST matches the accuracy of Gumbel-Softmax straight-through across all benchmarks: reversible

translated_title: 离散随机系统的倾向直通梯度
translated_abstract: 连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMCs）为应用科学、物理科学和生物科学中的离散随机动力学建模提供了基础支撑。然而，它们与现代基于梯度的机器学习的集成受到Gillespie类模拟算法中固有的硬分类事件选择的限制。我们利用仿射状态更新这一特性，通过对归一化反应倾向进行微分，获得了精确的单步条件均值敏感性。我们将这一反向传播规则与精确的正向轨迹相配对，定义了倾向直通（PST）估计器。在轨迹层面，我们展示了跨事件组合的单步敏感性可能偏离精确的多步敏感性。我们以封闭形式推导了由此产生的每步差异，并证明当存在仿射下游依赖关系时，该差异恒等于零。PST在所有基准测试中均达到了与Gumbel-Softmax直通方法相当的准确性：可逆
tldr: 提出倾向直通（PST）估计器，通过对归一化反应倾向微分获得精确的单步条件均值敏感性，使连续时间马尔可夫链的离散随机模拟系统能够与基于梯度的机器学习集成，并证明在仿射下游依赖下其每步差异恒为零。
en_tdlr: Proposes the propensity straight-through (PST) estimator, which obtains exact one-step conditional-mean sensitivities by differentiating normalized reaction propensities, enabling gradient-based learning for CTMC-based discrete stochastic simulations with provably zero per-step discrepancy under affine downstream dependence.
